rulesTestNames: lets each reader get only their own journey view
lets a claimant list only their own waiting journeys
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels organizer journey view triggers
read: only the view's own uid: gets it while a current manager of the organizer or while their claim is still being checked, and lists it with uid and waitingClaim equality; never while their account is deleted
write: server only; written per organizer from organizers, organizerClaimRequests, supplyIntakeRequests, events and organizerGrowthFacts, and deleted when its reader is no longer a manager or claimant
migrationNotes: journey equals what listMyOrganizerJourneys returns to that reader. The host-organizer-journey-views copy-forward migration creates views for every organizer with a manager or a pending claim.
listMyOrganizerJourneys stays deployed for released Host builds.
